MATCH (t:Team)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Player)-[:PlaysFor]->(pt:Team)
WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (p)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) }
  AND pt = t
  AND (pt.team_name = 'Boston Celtics' OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) <= 0 OR CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS INT64) < 0)
RETURN t.team_name AS col1, AVG(CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS DOUBLE)) AS col2

MATCH (t:Team)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document), (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document), (p)-[:PlaysFor]->(pt:Team)
WHERE pt.team_name = t.team_name
  AND (pt.team_name = 'Boston Celtics'
       OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) <= 0
       OR CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS INT64) < 0)
RETURN t.team_name AS col1, AVG(CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS DOUBLE)) AS col2
